21141.name: Gjallerbru
21141.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. Victory 3. When Defeated: The first player reveals Hall of Nastrond and Nidhogg, and puts them into play. Deal each other player 1 facedown encounter card.

21142.name: Hall of Nastrond
21142.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. Victory 4. When Defeated: The first player detaches Odin from the main scheme and takes control of him. Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card.
